meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤把 Python 代码(Flask、Django、FastAPI 等)部署到 Azure App Service。如果资源组、计划或网站不存在,它会自动创建;完成后会给出访问网址,不做额外检查。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Flask App Service、Django App Service、FastAPI App Service 等关键词,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service 时。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service。
say.note: 自动创建缺失资源并部署。

say.text: 把 Django 项目部署到 App Service。
say.note: 会检测框架,无需手动设启动命令。

howto.what_en: Claude will deploy Python code (Flask, Django, FastAPI, etc.) to Azure App Service. If the resource group, plan, or web app does not exist, it creates them; after deployment it prints the access URL and does not run extra checks.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions Flask App Service, Django App Service, FastAPI App Service keywords, or asks to deploy Python code to Azure App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service.
Deploy my Django project to App Service.
say_en.note: Detects the framework; no manual startup command needed.

say_en.text: Deploy a FastAPI app to App Service using uvicorn.
say_en.note: Sets the startup command before deploying.
